exposure: use of preprinted discharge prescriptions (with 10 vs. 20 morphine 5 mg pills)
outcome: discharge opioid prescribing (number of morphine 5 mg pills)
cohort: The study included 904 patients undergoing cesarean delivery under neuraxial anesthesia at a university-affiliated hospital from December 2020 to December 2021.
finding: In-hospital opioid consumption following cesarean delivery was low and associated with patient and care-related factors, while the size of discharge opioid prescriptions was primarily associated with the use of preprinted prescriptions.
